    """Rotate x left by k bits, wrapping the high bits around to the low end."""
    pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
    post bits.count_ones(out) == bits.count_ones(x)
    ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
    ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
    ex rotl8(181, 0) == 181
    v = int(x)
    r = (v << k) | (v >> (8 - k))
    return wrap_as[uint8](r)
